question: Who among the following was the leader of 1857 Revolt at Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bahadur Shah II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bahadur Shah II**, also known as **Bahadur Shah Zafar**, was the last Mughal emperor of India and served as the symbolic leader of the **1857 Revolt** at **Delhi**.
 
• He was proclaimed the **emperor of Hindustan** by the sepoys (Indian soldiers) who led the revolt, although his power was largely ceremonial.
 
• The revolt in Delhi was initiated by Indian soldiers of the **British East India Company**, and they sought Bahadur Shah II's leadership to legitimize their rebellion against British rule.
 
• Bahadur Shah Zafar provided a unifying figure for the rebels, but he did not have the political or military control to direct the revolt effectively.
 
• After the suppression of the revolt, Bahadur Shah II was captured by the British, exiled to **Rangoon** (modern-day Yangon in Myanmar), and the Mughal Empire was officially abolished in 1858</st
